policy: This file selects from a CODE-OWNED registry of XML/HTML namespace URIs; it cannot extend it.
RECOGNISED_NAMESPACE_URIS in assert-no-external-hosts.mjs is the registry. A uri that is not
in it fails the lint, so a CDN, font host, or API endpoint cannot be allowlisted here at all —
widening the registry is a source change a reviewer must approve.
A namespace URI is an identifier, never an address: nothing is ever fetched from it.
Matching is exact-string over the COMPLETE value, never a prefix and never truncated at a
Every entry MUST carry a non-empty 'reason'. An entry without one fails the lint, as does an

entries.reason: SVG namespace. Bundled inline SVG (brand marks, icons) legitimately carries xmlns="…/2000/svg"; it is an identifier, not fetched.
XLink namespace. Emitted by SVG tooling for xlink:href on <use>/<image> in bundled inline SVG; never dereferenced.
XHTML namespace. Appears in SVG <foreignObject> content and in serialized DOM fixtures; never dereferenced.
MathML namespace. react-dom's namespace table maps <math> to it when creating elements; it is an identifier passed to createElementNS, never fetched.
Core XML namespace, bound to the reserved xml: prefix (xml:lang, xml:space) in bundled inline SVG; never dereferenced.
